place: Bang Por, Maenam, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Custom-Designed Hillside Sea-View Villas in a Gated Bang Por Estate
blurb: Four large hillside plots remain in a gated estate of just ten villas above Bang Por, on Koh Samui’s north coast — each home designed from scratch with its buyer in a tropical-modern style, with an infinity pool that drops away toward the sea and protected land in front that can never be built on. Delivered turn-key with furniture custom-made in Thailand for each villa and full landscaping, from US$2,500,000 including land.
detail:
On a 26,000 m² hillside above Bang Por, about a kilometre from the beach on Koh Samui’s quiet north coast, a gated estate of only ten villas is taking shape. The land faces the sea across a protected natural zone where nothing may be built, so the views and the privacy are secured for good; along one edge runs a natural waterfall, and some plots sit right beside it. Access is controlled at the gate, with 24-hour security.

This is not a choice of fixed house types. Each villa is designed with its buyer by a Samui-based Thai architecture and interiors team with more than twenty years in practice, who stay alongside the client from first sketch to handover. Layouts, sizes and interiors are tailored to each owner, while a shared palette of local stone, stucco, timber and dark pitched roofs keeps the estate coherent. Amenities are shaped around how each owner lives — a private gym, a spa or massage room, a bar, a cinema or playroom can all be built into the plan. Every plot already comes with a concept design fitted to its size and slope, and the architecture is tropical modern — open plans, deep overhangs, high beamed ceilings and walls of glass that let the breeze move through the house.

Plots available

• Plot 2 · 1,920 m² of land · villa of about 1,250 m² (five suites, gym and sauna, four-car parking) · price on request
• Plot 3 · 1,832 m² of land · villa of about 1,100 m² (five suites, playroom and bar, gym) · price on request
• Plot 5 · 1,600 m² of land · villa from about 800 m² · from US$2,500,000 including land
• Plot 8 · 1,440 m² of land · villa from about 800 m² · from US$2,500,000 including land

Villas range from about 800 m² up to 1,400 m², with five to seven bathrooms, and each design can be scaled to a budget within a minimum build for its plot. The final price is fixed through a detailed bill of quantities agreed before work begins. One villa in the estate is already complete, and the interior photographs here show its finish.

Each house is built in reinforced concrete to a five-star resort standard. Infinity-edge saltwater pools are set so the water appears to run straight into the sea. Inside, living areas are finished in stone or premium tile and bedrooms in hardwood or WPC, with ducted or cassette air-conditioning, stone-topped kitchens and a separate chef’s kitchen, and bathrooms in natural stone. The estate has its own 500 kVA transformer with individual meters at government rates and a backup generator, a project water supply or an optional private deep well, rainwater harvesting and greywater recycling, with a 15 kVA solar system and battery available as an upgrade.

Villas are handed over fully turn-key. The furniture is designed specifically for each villa and made in Thailand, indoors and out, and the price also covers appliances, bedding, every finish and the full landscaping of the garden. An after-sales maintenance team looks after the homes once owners move in. Construction takes roughly 14–16 months from the start of work. Thirty percent of the land price and thirty percent of the build price are due on final design approval, with the rest of the schedule set out in the bill of quantities. Concept designs, floor plans and drone footage for each plot are available on request.
